scoring_justification: Full recompute of skyrmion number from raw OOMMF magnetization fields is infeasible in checker sandbox; instead verify that reported Q and count match expected qualitative regimes (labyrinth vs isolated skyrmion) for each condition.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected skyrmion metrics (Q magnitude and count) per simulation condition
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 4 and text: zero-field labyrinth domains (no skyrmions, Q≈0), isolated skyrmions under 200-250 mT field (topological charge |Q|≈1, count 1), thermal stability at 100K (Q≈1), collapse at 150K (Q≈0), and robustness to exchange stiffness up to 15 pJ/m (Q≈1).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper's reported outcomes; exact values are ideal expected outcomes for a correct simulation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Gold values reflect the deterministic physical picture described in the paper: a labyrinth domain has topological charge 0, a single isolated skyrmion has topological charge magnitude 1. These are not arbitrary but follow from the physics of the system under the specified conditions.

outputs.description: Skyrmion metrics for each simulation condition. The checker compares skyrmion_number (within ±0.5) and skyrmion_count (exact match) against hidden expected values.

output_contract.notes: The agent must produce the skyrmion number (topological charge) and skyrmion count for all six conditions. The hidden checker uses a tolerance of 0.5 for skyrmion_number and exact match for skyrmion_count.
